activities.anchor: every antihypertensive is a handle on one of those factors
activities.caption: pair each drug class with its handle on the equation
activities.name: cvHandleMatch

config.prompt: Every agent acts on one factor of the haemodynamic identity — pair class with handle:

pairs.right: cut cardiac output at its rate and contractility terms
shrink plasma volume, cutting stroke volume
dilate arterioles, cutting systemic vascular resistance

config.why: The baroreflex resists any univariate assault — which is why combination therapy is the norm.

activities.anchor: This reflex-compensation logic explains why single-drug therapy often disappoints
activities.caption: which regimen lands lower?
activities.name: cvReflexTrace

config.prompt: Two regimens cut resistance by the same amount; one also blocks the compensatory rise in output. Which curve is the combination therapy?
config.why: Vasodilate alone and the compensatory rise in rate and stroke volume blunts the fall; block the compensation and the pressure reduction is real — low doses of two or three agents beat escalating one.

activities.anchor: the physical reason a 70% coronary stenosis matters so much
activities.caption: call the fourth-power penalty
activities.name: cvPoiseuilleEstimate

config.prompt: Poiseuille's law: flow scales with the fourth power of radius. An arteriole's radius is halved. By what factor does its resistance rise?
config.why: Resistance scales inversely with radius to the fourth power: 2⁴ = 16 — why "minor" narrowings under high flow demand become limiting.

config.prompt: From injured endothelium to silent stenosis — drag the sequence into order:
items: Endothelium injured — by pressure, smoking toxins, glucose — becomes permeable
LDL particles lodge in the intima and are chemically modified
Monocytes invade, engulf the modified LDL and become foam cells
Smooth muscle migrates in and lays a fibrous cap over a necrotic lipid core
For decades the plaque grows outward, the vessel remodelling to preserve the lumen — silent
config.why: Twenty years of outward remodelling keep the lumen open — which is why the disease stays silent until the cap's integrity, not the degree of narrowing, decides the day.

activities.caption: file each finding under the line of evidence it belongs to
activities.name: cvLdlBuckets

config.prompt: LDL's causality rests on three independent lines — file each finding:

items.label: a log-linear dose-response between LDL and events, with no floor
lifelong low LDL via inherited PCSK9 loss-of-function: ~88% lower coronary risk
statins, ezetimibe and PCSK9 antibodies all reduce events in proportion to absolute LDL reduction
roughly 22% fewer major events per 1 mmol/L per year of treatment

config.why: What matters is cumulative exposure — LDL-years — which is why guidelines talk about starting earlier, not just lower.

activities.anchor: as a plumbing problem solved by roto-rooting
activities.caption: true or false — what the catheter lab buys
activities.name: cvStentJudge

statements.s: Stents relieve obstructive stenoses and save lives during acute infarction.
statements.why: The rescue use is real — the contested case is stable disease.

statements.s: For stable disease, the ISCHEMIA trial found invasive revascularisation reduced death and infarction versus optimal medical therapy.
statements.why: It did not: the disease is in the vessel wall and the blood, not the narrowest spot.

statements.s: Statins, blood-pressure control and smoking cessation prevent more deaths than any catheter lab.
statements.why: The unglamorous trio wins on population mortality.

activities.anchor: because that is where measured end-organ damage curves begin to inflect
activities.caption: place the marker on the 2017 systolic threshold
activities.name: cvThresholdPlace

config.prompt: Hypertension is defined operationally. Place the marker on the systolic threshold (mmHg) adopted by the 2017 ACC/AHA criteria:
config.why: 130 systolic under the 2017 criteria — 140/90 classically — set where damage curves inflect, not where symptoms begin.

activities.anchor: When a coronary thrombus occludes flow
activities.caption: walk the acute-coronary pathway
activities.name: cvStemiBranch

config.root: An acute coronary presentation arrives. The clock is part of the therapy.

start.text: The 12-lead ECG shows ST-segment elevation. Where does the pathway go?

choices.label: Straight to the catheter lab for reperfusion
choices.feedback: Transmural injury on the tracing: minutes are muscle.

choices.label: Ward observation, reassess in the morning
choices.feedback: Every 30 minutes of delay measurably raises one-year mortality.

cath.text: Stenting the culprit artery or thrombolysis salvages jeopardised muscle; troponin assays confirm the injury — proteins released by dying myocytes, rising within hours, near-perfectly specific. Then the rhythm questions: a chaotic ventricular rhythm needs the defibrillator's non-synchronous reset.

delay.text: The salvage window is measured in hours and closes by the hour — reperfusion is the therapy the clock is keeping.

config.why: The diagnosis stack is fast — ECG, troponin — because the salvage window closes on its own.
